moved.sentence: **Attach citation metadata at retrieval time, not after generation** — pre-embedding citations gave the best observed accuracy (~92% in Perplexity).

judged.note: Rule keeps retrieval-time attachment, the contrast with after-generation, and the ~92% Perplexity evidence, at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Cite at the claim / sentence level with the supporting quote.

judged.note: Rule keeps claim/sentence-level citation with the supporting quote at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Keep stable, numbered citations through summarization.

judged.note: Rule keeps stable, numbered citations through summarization at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: The orchestrator **plans and synthesizes; it never does ground research itself.**

judged.note: Plan-and-synthesize kept at SHOULD and the ban on ground research in the orchestrator strengthened to MUST NOT.

moved.sentence: Budget per-subtopic specialists with isolated context.

judged.note: Rule keeps per-subtopic specialists, budgeting and isolated context at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: **Outline before searching;** reflect at both supervisor and worker level.

judged.note: The two rules together keep outline-before-searching and reflection at both supervisor and worker level, each at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Stop on **coverage** (two independent sources, or one authoritative one), not on a loop count.

judged.note: Rule keeps coverage as the stop condition with both thresholds (two independent or one authoritative) and the not-a-loop-count contrast.

moved.sentence: Outline-driven report with a **confidence / coverage indicator per section.**

judged.note: Rule keeps the outline-driven report and the per-section confidence / coverage indicator at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Keep intermediate artifacts (outline, mind-map) for human review.

judged.note: Rule keeps the outline and mind-map examples and the human-review purpose at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: Multi-engine, domain-routed sources; **rerank and quality-gate before the LLM sees them.**

judged.note: The two rules keep multi-engine, domain-routed sourcing and rerank plus quality-gate before the LLM sees sources.

moved.sentence: Filter by freshness and authority / venue reputation.

judged.note: Rule keeps filtering by freshness and by authority / venue reputation at SHOULD.
Rule keeps full pages over snippets at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: A **dedicated reviewer** with explicit acceptance criteria.

judged.note: Rule keeps the dedicated reviewer and its explicit acceptance criteria at SHOULD.

moved.sentence: **Cross-source corroboration** is the primary anti-hallucination defense.

judged.note: Rule keeps the claim that cross-source corroboration is the primary anti-hallucination defense and adds a SHOULD to corroborate.

moved.sentence: Check URL health / citation existence — even top tools hallucinate 3-13% of URLs.

judged.note: Rule keeps URL health / citation-existence checking and the 3-13% hallucinated-URL evidence.
Rule keeps the statement that perspective diversity is structural anti-hallucination and adds a SHOULD to build it in.
